_doc: GDPval judge panel, App. A.5.2. Each member judges each candidate-vs-expert pair once (no A/B swap audits); visible A/B order is drawn from random.Random(seed) in cohort order. Loop settings: up to 100 turns (warning at 20 left), context summarization at 0.9 of the window, a 40-call code_exec budget per attempt with 6,000-character results and 600 s per command, a 10,800 s wall clock per attempt, and one fresh retry after no finish, a timeout or an agent error. parallelism: concurrent judge sessions across all members; it does not change results.
